description: Free, no sign-in. Use when you have a rule id from search_rules and need its full detail: the requirement, deadline, evidence to keep, penalty, legal basis on legislation.gov.uk or GOV.UK, official guidance links and its lettance.com page. Quote the legal basis when you rely on it. Read-only. Unknown ids return an error rather than a guess.
name: get_rule
title: Get a landlord rule
